title: VooPoo Vinci Spark 220 Box Mod
description: The Voopoo Vinci Spark 220 Mod is a high-powered dual-18650 vape mod, designed for vapers who want full control over their vaping experience. Delivering up to 220W of power, this advanced mod features a 1.47” TFT colour display, a sleek Animated Starlight Coating, and multiple power modes for a fully customisable vape. At the heart of the Vinci Spark 220 is the GENE.TT 2.0 chipset, offering a selection of Smart, RBA, and TC-TRC modes to suit different vaping styles. Smart Mode automatically detects and adjusts wattage to match the coil, while RBA Mode gives vapers the flexibility to manually set power output between 5W and 220W. TC-TRC Mode allows for precise temperature adjustments when using Ni200, Titanium, or stainless steel coils. Bringing an extra layer of personalisation, the Animated Starlight Coating features 84 embedded LEDs, creating an immersive, interactive lighting effect. With multiple UI themes, users can modify the screen appearance and lighting settings or disable them entirely for a more understated, discreet look. Built for convenience, the Vinci Spark 220 Mod includes a magnetic battery cover, making it easy to access the dual-18650 battery compartment (batteries sold separately). USB-C fast charging (5V/3A) ensures quick and efficient recharging, while the multi-function button provides a seamless way to adjust settings, toggle lighting, and fire the device. Designed with durability and usability in mind, the Vinci Spark 220 Mod features a zinc alloy chassis, an ergonomic grip, and seven built-in safety protections for added peace of mind. Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this kit.
